_comment: Test kit mailed to Stompa before every test (Messenger > Commando, via SPT's 'spt give'). Stompa loses the kit in each test raid, so every new kitId mails the whole kit; F4 in the menus resends it. Ghost/lab tests: lean (only what the test needs, presets with their magazine + one magazine of ammo). Normal raids without ghost (Stompa, 2026-10-16): a full META-style kit with plenty of magazines and ammo + the meds a raid needs. 'spt give' sends a template with a default preset as the whole preset (weapons with their magazine, armour with its plates); magazines and meds come one per count, ammo split into stacks. Template ids verified in the SPT 4.1.6 database (2026-10-19; RGD-5 2026-11-01; MP-133, 7mm buckshot, Grizzly 40 2026-11-19).
note: 1.2.1 Fika client tests (testing.md "fika-client-2"): M4A1 + one magazine to wound bots before killing them and to shoot corpses, 2 RGD-5 for the blast throw on a corpse (corpse fix); MP-133 with one tube of 7mm buckshot (head within 5 m) and one of Grizzly 40 slugs (head at range) for killing headshots as a client (remote late death). Lean kit.
